{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Unit Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: ["master"]
  pull_request:
    branches: ["master"]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Use Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: 14
      - name: Cache npm dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.npm
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-npm-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-npm-
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run lint
      - run: npm test
        env:
          FORCE_COLOR: "1"
      - name: Test documentation
        run: |
          npm install typedoc@0.25.0
          npx typedoc src/index.ts --excludePrivate --excludeExternals --treatValidationWarningsAsErrors
",
  "rationale": "Applied two evidence-supported optimizations: (1) Added a custom job timeout of 10 minutes (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT) to bound runaway executions, supported by experiment batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508 which showed 26.8% elapsed time savings. (2) Added npm dependency caching via actions/cache (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE / P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE) to avoid repeated downloads, supported by experiment batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2 demonstrating a similar cache step for pip. Changed `npm install` to `npm ci` for reproducible installs leveraging the cached packages. All existing test, lint, and documentation steps are preserved.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508", "experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2"]
}
